title: MySQL: decode cloning packets
description:
Some info about this can be found on https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/clone-plugin.html
however I didn't find much protocol documentation.

To do cloning you need two hosts and then execute something like this:

```sql
SET GLOBAL clone_valid_donor_list='127.0.0.1:27233';
CLONE INSTANCE FROM root@127.0.0.1:27233 IDENTIFIED BY 'msandbox' REQUIRE NO SSL;
```

Note that multiple TCP streams are used.

![image](/uploads/f5ebcf68cefdbb6ed703149943e5bb56/image.png)
